gate.waking: Waking up the server. After a quiet period the first visit can take up to a minute.

waiting.title: WhatsApp isn't connected yet
waiting.body: A manager needs to connect your company's WhatsApp number before the inbox, contacts and campaigns can work. You'll get in automatically as soon as it's done.

setup.title: Connect your WhatsApp number
setup.subtitle: Everything in this CRM runs through your WhatsApp Business number. Connect it once and your whole team uses it.

why.title: What we do with these
items: Find your WhatsApp numbers for you
Store the token encrypted — no one sees it again

credentials.title: Connect your Meta app
credentials.body: Paste two values from Meta. We use them to find your numbers and set everything else up for you.
credentials.tokenHint: Starts with EAA. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
credentials.tokenShort: This looks short for a permanent token. Temporary tokens from the API Setup page stop working after 24 hours.
credentials.tokenFormat: Access tokens start with EAA — check you copied the whole token.
credentials.secretFormat: An App Secret is 32 letters and numbers.
credentials.keepSaved: Saved — leave empty to keep it

business.title: Which business is this?
business.body: Meta didn't say which business this token belongs to. Paste your Business ID and we'll find its numbers.
business.label: Business ID
business.hint: Business Settings → Business info. It's also the number after business_id= in the address bar.

steps: Open Business Settings → Users → System users and click Add. Name it (for example “CRM”) and choose the Admin role.
Click Assign assets. Give it Full control of your app, then Full control of your WhatsApp account.
Click Generate token, choose your app, set Expiration to Never and tick these permissions:
Copy the token straight away — Meta shows it only once. If your business needs a second admin to approve, ask them and come back.
For the App Secret, open your app in Meta for Developers → App settings → Basic, then click Show next to App secret.

number.title: Choose the number to connect
number.found_one: We found {{count}} number in your Meta account.
number.found_other: We found {{count}} numbers in your Meta account.
number.testWarn: Meta's test number can only message up to 5 numbers you add in Meta. Use your real number for customers.
number.notFinishedWarn: This number isn't finished in Meta yet, so it can't send or receive. Finish registering it in WhatsApp Manager first, or pick another.

none.title: No numbers found
none.body: This token can't see any WhatsApp numbers. Check that the system user has Full control of your WhatsApp account, then generate the token again.

finish.title: Connecting {{number}}

rows.subscribe: Linking your app to the WhatsApp account

finish.successBody: {{number}} is connected. Your approved templates are being imported in the background.
finish.attentionBody: Your number is connected, but this needs fixing before everything works.
finish.skip: Continue to the CRM — I'll fix it later

register.title: Move your number to this CRM
register.body: Meta won't let this CRM send from your number yet. If it's still registered with another app or provider (for example 360dialog), enter the number's two-step verification PIN to move it here. If two-step verification is off, the 6 digits you enter become the new PIN.
register.where: Don't know the PIN? Set a new one in WhatsApp Manager → Phone numbers → your number → Two-step verification.
register.label: 6-digit PIN
register.done: Done — this CRM can now send from your number.
register.stillBlocked: The number is now registered here, but Meta still refuses sends. That usually means the WhatsApp account is still billed through another provider's credit line (for example 360dialog) — add your own payment method in Meta to replace it.

webhook.title: Connect incoming messages by hand
webhook.body: We couldn't set this up automatically. In your Meta app open WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook → Edit, paste these two values, click Verify and save, then subscribe to messages.
webhook.stillMissing: Meta isn't sending messages here yet. Check both values and that messages is subscribed.

payment.title: Add a payment method in Meta
payment.body: Meta blocks messages you start — templates and campaigns — until the WhatsApp account has a working payment method. Replies to customers who message you still work.

errors.TOKEN_REQUIRED: Paste your access token to continue.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Meta didn't accept this token. Check you copied all of it and that it hasn't been revoked.
errors.TOKEN_SCOPES: This token is missing permissions. Generate it again with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management ticked.
errors.APP_SECRET_REQUIRED: Paste your App Secret to continue. Without it, customer messages can't be verified and won't reach the inbox.
errors.APP_SECRET_INVALID: This App Secret belongs to a different app than the token. Copy both from the same app.
errors.NUMBER_UNREACHABLE: Meta couldn't find this number with this token.
errors.PIN_MISMATCH: That PIN doesn't match. Set a new one in WhatsApp Manager and try again.
errors.REGISTER_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Meta asks you to wait a while before trying again.
errors.MANAGER_ONLY: Only a manager can change the WhatsApp connection.
errors.ENCRYPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: This server can't store credentials securely yet. Ask whoever runs the server to set CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details look wrong. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.PHONE_NUMBER_ID_TAKEN: This number is already connected to another workspace on this platform.

health.title: Connection health
health.loadFailed: Couldn't run the checks right now.

codes.TOKEN_INVALID: Not accepted by Meta — reconnect with a new token
codes.TOKEN_EXPIRES: Expires {{detail}} — replace it with a permanent token
codes.QUALITY_RED: Quality is low — Meta may limit sending soon
codes.QUALITY_YELLOW: Quality is medium — watch for customer blocks and reports
codes.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: Meta is blocking messages from this account
codes.PAYMENT_METHOD: No working payment method — templates and campaigns are blocked
codes.NUMBER_NOT_VERIFIED: The number isn't verified with WhatsApp yet
codes.WEBHOOK_OK: Customer messages arrive in the inbox
codes.WEBHOOK_MISSING: Not set up — customer messages won't arrive
codes.WEBHOOK_NO_MESSAGES: Not subscribed to messages — customer messages won't arrive
codes.NO_APP_SECRET: App Secret missing — reconnect to add it
codes.APP_SECRET_INVALID: App Secret doesn't match the app — reconnect
codes.SENDING_OK: This CRM can send from your number
codes.NOT_REGISTERED_HERE: Meta won't let this app send from your number yet — usually because it's still billed through another provider's credit line, or registered with their app

health.managerOnly: Only managers can change the WhatsApp connection.

panel.disconnectBody: Your whole team will stop sending and receiving messages until a manager connects a number again.

banner.brokenBody: Messages can't be sent or received right now.
banner.askManager: A manager can fix this in Settings → WhatsApp.
banner.expand: WhatsApp needs attention — tap for details

sendingBlocked.title: WhatsApp sending has stopped
sendingBlocked.body: Meta is refusing to send from your number — usually an unpaid balance or a changed payment method. Open "Pay in Meta" → WhatsApp Business accounts tab → account {{waba}}, pay the balance or set your card as the payment method, then press "Check again". Paused campaigns resume by themselves.
sendingBlocked.bodyPayment: Meta couldn't charge the WhatsApp account, so sending stopped. Open "Pay in Meta" → account {{waba}}, update the card or pay the balance, then press "Check again". Paused campaigns resume by themselves.
sendingBlocked.stillBlocked: Meta is still refusing sends. It can take a few minutes after paying — try again shortly.

billing.title: Billing & payments
billing.okBody: Meta is letting your number send. If a balance is due or you need to change the card, use the buttons below.
billing.blockedBody: Meta has stopped sending from your number — usually an unpaid balance or a payment-method problem. Pay, then press "Check now"; paused campaigns resume by themselves.
billing.accountId: WhatsApp Business account ID (find it in Meta’s list)
billing.step1: Press "Pay now in Meta", then open the "WhatsApp Business accounts" tab.
billing.step2: Find account {{waba}} — if it shows "Pay Now", pay the balance, and make sure the payment method is your card, not another company such as 360dialog.
billing.step3: Come back and press "Check now". It can take a few minutes after paying.
